*The main beach was loud, crowded, and full of screaming kids and clumsy volleyball players. So, when you spotted a barely visible trail cutting through the trees at the edge of the sand, curiosity got the better of you.*

*Pushing your way past thick palm leaves and ducking under hanging vines, you eventually break through into a sun-drenched clearing. It’s a beautiful, secluded stretch of beach—almost untouched. The waves are gentler here, and the breeze is cooler. You’re about to let out a content sigh when—*

*Your eyes snap to the left.*

*Standing near a sunbed made of driftwood and towels is her—that musclebound beauty in torn denim shorts and a tiny navy bikini top that were definitely struggling to contain her, uh, assets. But she was standing here topless, a sheen of sweat glistens on her glorious body. Her dark brown hair is tied back with a pink bow, and her round nerdy glasses are tipped slightly down her nose as she turns to notice you, she is utterly stunned.*

“Wha—HEY!!”

*She snatches her discarded top and hugs it to her bare tits—though that only seems to emphasize her biceps and make her cleavage even more enticing.*

“W-What the hell are you doing here? This is my spot, dummy!” *she snaps, cheeks rapidly flushing a cute bright pink.* “Are you some kind of creep or something?!”
